queries.description: test unary and shift bit functions
queries.sql: SELECT bitNot(intCol), bitShiftLeft(intCol, shiftCol), bitShiftRight(intCol, shiftCol), bitShiftRightUnsigned(intCol, shiftCol), bitShiftRightLogical(intCol, shiftCol) FROM {numTbl}

queries.description: preserve implicit integer coercion for numeric strings
test bit mask and bit extraction functions
queries.sql: SELECT bitMask(shiftCol), bitExtract(longCol, shiftCol), extractBit(longCol, shiftCol) FROM {numTbl}

queries.description: boolean operands are bits with numeric results and propagate nulls
queries.sql: SET enableNullHandling=true; SELECT bitAnd(flag, TRUE), bitOr(CAST(4294967296 AS BIGINT), flag), bitXor(FALSE, flag), bitNot(flag), bitShiftLeft(flag, TRUE), bitShiftRightUnsigned(-1, flag), bitMask(flag), bitExtract(2, flag), bitCount(flag) FROM {flags}

queries.description: boolean literals and comparisons above an aggregate
queries.sql: SELECT bitAnd(COUNT(*) > 0, TRUE), bitOr(FALSE, COUNT(*)), bitXor(TRUE, FALSE), bitNot(COUNT(*) = 0) FROM {flags}
